title: One Day After Hatching, These Ducklings Jump From 50 Feet Up

scenes.text: They're one day old. Now they have to jump.
Wood ducks nest in tree holes that can be over 50 feet up. The ducklings can't fly.
Their mother flies down and calls from the ground. She does not help them.
One by one they leap. They're so light the fall doesn't harm them. They bounce, get up, and run to her.
If holes are scarce, several hens lay in one nest. Up to 40 eggs have been found in a single box.
Then she leads them to the water. A 50-foot drop at one day old. That's the first morning.

description:
Wood ducks nest in tree cavities and nest boxes that can be over 50 feet above the ground; about a day after hatching, the flightless ducklings jump down to their mother, who calls but does not help them.
They are so light that the fall does not injure them. When nest sites are scarce, several females lay in one nest, and up to 40 eggs have been found in a single box.
Would you jump at one day old?
subject: wood duck
first_comment: They bounce and run to mum. Which baby animal has the toughest first day?
